calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.product_key,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.store_key = 4  -- Helsinki Pitäjänmäki
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
GROUP BY p.product_key, p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS total_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.store_key = 4
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21

SELECT 
  p.sku,

  p.subcategory,
  p.brand
FROM dim_product p
